title: Documented bugs, exploits and quirks
prerequisites: Version 1.3 (GOG) program and data, with none of the optional [P] patches applied.
A runner that can fix the dice stream and read game state.
Entries marked VERSION-SPECIFIC in notes describe other versions and must not be required of 1.3.

scenarios.title: Bring a dead character back with a damage spell
steps: Have a character whose status is dead in the party during a combat.
Target the dead character with Burning Hands from a magic-user.
Bandage the character from another character's combat menu.
Repeat with Cause Light Wounds from a cleric.
expect: A dead character is a valid target.
A targeted damage spell that does under 10 damage leaves the character 'dying' instead of dead, so Bandage works.
Burning Hands always works.
Cause Light Wounds needs a successful touch roll first.
sources: [P] digest §5 Technical (§13.1): 'Single-target damage spells raise the dead'
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say what happens when the spell does 10 or more. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Duplicate items with Remove, Save and Load
steps: Go to a training hall.
Remove one character.
Save.
Create a dummy character.
Trade the items to the dummy.
Remove the dummy.
Drop everyone else.
Load the save.
Add the dummy back.
To repeat: Remove the dummy, Save, Add it back, and return to the Trade step.
expect: After the Load the original holders have their items again and the dummy, once Added, holds copies: two copies exist.
disagreements: Digest §4 UI says 'Loading a save deletes any characters previously Removed', yet here a Removed dummy survives a Load. The digest does not reconcile them.
scenarios.notes: Steps are the digest's nine, in order. Step 2's purpose (a Removed character) is not explained in the digest. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Reach Constitution 22 or 0 for oversized hit point gains
steps: Use several Manuals of Bodily Health (copies from restarts or duplication) on one character until Constitution is exactly 22; train a level with fixed dice.
Separately: kill and Raise Dead a character at a temple repeatedly until Constitution is 0; train a level.
expect: Con 22 gives +7 HP per level to a warrior or +5 to others.
Con 0 gives +8 HP per level.
disagreements: Manual of Bodily Health: [P] +1 Constitution after a month; [GB] 'doesn't seem to do anything here'; [SP] 'worth 25,000 gold… we sold it'.
scenarios.notes: The Manual is found in Mendor's Library (05-mendors-library). Constitution is defined only for 3-20 and correct only for 4-18. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Restart the game keeping the characters
steps: At a training hall Remove every character.
Quit to DOS and start the game again.
At the party menu Add the removed characters.
Begin Adventuring.
expect: The characters keep their XP, items and money in a fresh game.
scenarios.notes: Fresh game state means quests and one-time treasures are available again; the digest states only that XP, items and money are kept. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Re-roll level-up hit points
steps: At a training hall Save.
Train a character and read the HP gained.
Drop everyone.
Load the save and Train again.
expect: Each attempt rolls the hit die again, so the player can repeat until the gain is high.
scenarios.notes: A runner needs a different dice state on the second attempt to see a different roll. qa/findings.json classic-dice-seed-fixed (fixed) is related: every launch once rolled the same dice. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Create dummy characters to collect their starting gold
steps: At the party menu Create a character, Trade its starting gold to a real character, Drop the dummy. Repeat.
expect: The gold stays with the real character; nothing prevents repeating it.
sources: [P] digest §4 Character creation and stats (Starting gold)
scenarios.notes: [P]: it 'works but is not worth the time'. The digest does not spell out the steps; these follow from the starting-gold rule and the Trade command. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Heavy items at the top of the inventory reduce item theft
steps: Arrange a character's inventory with body armor in the first slot; arrange another with a light item first.
Trigger an item theft with fixed dice (New Phlan tavern pickpocket, Kobold Caves, a bribe or a surrender).
expect: The chance of losing items is sharply lower for the character with the heaviest items at the top.
sources: [P] digest §5 Other documented quirks (sources of item theft)
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no numbers. The mechanism is probably the ROB opcode iterating the item list (acceptance.quirks.technical.ecl-rob-opcode); that link is this author's reading, not stated in the digest. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Real-time midnight rollover breaks timers
steps: Set the host clock to just before midnight and start a timed wait (a DELAY in a script, or a combat message pause).
Let the real clock pass 00:00:00.
expect: The original's timers misbehave when the real-time clock rolls over midnight.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say how they break (hang or skip). The port's DOS clock is 'fixed date, deterministic time' (qa/inventory/classic.json classic.platform.dos-clock), so this may not be reachable; record the decision. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Quitting character creation part-way leaks memory
steps: Start Create, then back out before keeping the character. Repeat many times.
Watch for the heap error.
expect: Each abandoned creation leaks memory in the original; enough repeats exhaust the heap.
scenarios.notes: See technical.heap-error-message for what is shown. The digest gives no count. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: A name with too many DOS-invalid characters crashes the game
steps: Create a character whose name is made of characters DOS does not allow in file names.
Keep the character, then Remove it (which writes a file named after the character).
expect: The original crashes.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say how many invalid characters are 'too many' or at which step the crash comes; the Remove step is this author's guess at the file write. A port must not corrupt saves here; decide whether to reproduce a crash. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Modify can lower stats below the minimum
steps: Create a dwarf (Con minimum 12). Choose Modify and lower Constitution below 12.
expect: The game accepts values below the racial and class minima.
scenarios.notes: Same rule as acceptance.mechanics.creation.modify. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Strength 19-25 cannot bash an easy door
steps: Raise a character's Strength to 19 or more (Potion of Giant Strength).
Bash a door that a Strength 18 character opens easily, with fixed dice.
expect: The Strength 19-25 character fails to bash the easy door.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not list the bash chances or define 'easy'. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Constitution is defined only for 3-20 and correct only for 4-18
steps: Set Constitution to 3, 19, 20, 21, 22 and 0 in turn and train a level with fixed dice.
expect: Con 4-18 follow the table.
Warriors get no +5 at 19-20.
Values outside 3-20 read past the table: Con 22 gives +7 (warrior) or +5; Con 0 gives +8.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say what Con 3 does wrong. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Multi-class Constitution hit point bonus is wrong after level 1
steps: Train one class of a two-class character with Con 17 and fixed dice; read HP gained.
expect: HP gained = (die + every class's Con modifier) / number of classes, rounded down, minimum 1, so the Con bonus is added once per class before dividing.
scenarios.notes: Extra HP from this bug carries over to Curse of the Azure Bonds (digest §6). Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Con poison-save bonus also applies to paralysis and death
steps: Force a dwarf, gnome or halfling to save vs paralysis and vs death magic with fixed d20 rolls at the boundary.
expect: The Con/3.5 bonus meant for poison is applied to all paralysis/poison/death saves.
sources: [P] digest §4 Character creation and stats (Racial abilities)
scenarios.notes: 'Paralysis save fixes' is one of the optional patches not to apply. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Haste and Slow show movement the wrong way on the character screen
steps: Cast Haste on a character and View it; read the movement value. Move it in combat and count squares.
Repeat with Slow.
expect: The character screen shows movement adjusted in the wrong direction.
Actual movement in combat is correct.
scenarios.notes: Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: No aging until 256 years have passed
steps: Play or advance the clock for several game years and read characters' ages.
Advance past 256 years.
expect: Ages do not advance with the calendar.
After 256 years characters age 1 year per minute.
scenarios.notes: Haste still adds a year per casting. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Racial to-hit bonuses fail against monsters #2, #7 and #28; no elf bonus with the Fine Composite Long Bow
steps: Attack monster #2 with a dwarf and a gnome; attack #7 and #28 with a dwarf; use fixed d20 rolls at the boundary.
Fire a Fine Composite Long Bow with an elf.
expect: The +1 racial bonus is not applied against #2 (dwarf and gnome), #7 and #28 (dwarf).
The elf gets no +1 with the Fine Composite Long Bow.
data: #2 GOBLIN GUARD and #7 HOBGOBLIN LDR (names from digest §3.1)
#28: the digest's Textile House section labels SKULLCRUSHER '#28 [sic]'
sources: [P] digest §4 Character creation and stats (Racial abilities)
scenarios.notes: The digest does not name #28 for certain. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Single-target damage spells raise the dead
steps: See exploit.raise-dead-with-damage-spells.
expect: A single-target damage spell cast on a dead character can change the status from dead to dying.
scenarios.notes: Listed separately in the digest's Technical list; same behaviour as the exploit. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Thief skills do not update promptly
steps: Read a thief's skills. Change something that should alter them (train a level, or change Dexterity). Read the skills again at once, and again after reloading or re-entering.
expect: The skill values lag behind the change.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say what finally refreshes them; measure on the original. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Removing a charm may not restore a hired NPC
steps: Have an enemy charm a hired NPC in combat.
Remove the charm (Dispel Magic, or end of combat).
expect: The NPC may not return to the party's side.
scenarios.notes: 'May' is the digest's word; conditions are not given. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Dispel Magic cannot check the caster level for effects that do not store it
steps: Cast Dispel Magic on effects from items or scripts (no stored caster level) with fixed dice.
expect: The level comparison is not made correctly for effects that carry no caster level.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether such effects are always or never dispelled. Not checkable until measured on the original. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Shield spell does not stop the Wand of Magic Missiles
steps: Cast Shield on a character. Have an enemy cast Magic Missile at it, then use a Wand of Magic Missiles on it.
expect: The wand's missiles do damage through Shield.
scenarios.notes: The Nomad shaman carries a Wand of Magic Missiles with 50 charges (13-nomad-camp). That Shield stops the spell version is implied, not stated. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Mirror Image works only against targeted spells
steps: Cast Mirror Image; take a melee hit and a missile hit; then be targeted by a spell.
expect: Physical attacks ignore the images.
scenarios.notes: The 'Mirror Image fix' is one of the optional patches not to apply. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Coin totals over 65535 gold can be lost in a transaction
steps: Give one character more than 13107 platinum (over 65535 gold in value).
Buy or sell something in a shop.
Read money.
expect: Money above the 16-bit limit can be lost in the transaction.
Sale remainders (gold left after converting to platinum) are always lost.
scenarios.notes: Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: A Bag of Holding may need several pick-up attempts
steps: Find a Bag of Holding in treasure and choose Take repeatedly.
expect: The Take can fail and succeed on a later attempt.
scenarios.notes: The digest gives neither the cause nor where a Bag of Holding is found. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Flame Tongue has no special effect
steps: Attack a fire-vulnerable or regenerating monster with a Flame Tongue and with a plain magic sword of the same plus; fixed dice.
expect: Damage and effect are the same as an ordinary sword of its plus.
scenarios.notes: Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Keoghtum's Ointment turns poisoned characters into dead ones
steps: Use Keoghtum's Ointment on a character whose status is poisoned.
expect: The character's status becomes dead.
scenarios.notes: Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Manual of Bodily Health applies its hit point adjustment wrongly
steps: Read max HP. Use the Manual of Bodily Health; wait the month; read Constitution and max HP.
expect: Constitution rises by 1 after a month.
The HP adjustment that goes with it is applied incorrectly.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say what the wrong adjustment is. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: A randomly generated Sling weighs 8 lb
steps: Obtain a Sling from random magic item generation and one from a shop; View both.
expect: The random Sling shows a weight of 8 lb (80 coins).
scenarios.notes: Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Wands of Fireball and Lightning Bolt allow a save vs spell
steps: Use each wand on a target with fixed d20 rolls either side of its save vs spell.
expect: The save is made on the spell column, not rod/staff/wand.
scenarios.notes: The Wand of Paralyzation saves vs paralyzation (acceptance.quirks.adaptational.wand-of-paralyzation). Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The AHNKHEG's acid is not typed as acid
steps: Let an AHNKHEG use its acid on a character; separately damage a troll with it if possible.
expect: The damage carries no acid type.
scenarios.notes: Visible only through effects that depend on damage type (troll regeneration). AHNKHEGs are met on the west wilderness map and in the Anhkheg lair (11-wilderness, 12-wilderness-lairs). Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: GENHEERIS cannot memorize spells
steps: Recruit GENHEERIS in the Inner Tower. Encamp and open Memorize for him; rest.
expect: He cannot re-memorize spells once cast.
scenarios.notes: Also covered in 23-inner-tower. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The ACOLYTE can be Modified
steps: Hire the ACOLYTE (#108) at hall 14. Go to a training hall and choose Modify on him.
expect: Modify is allowed because he has 0 XP.
His race is 'Monster', which indexes past the racial table (array out of bounds).
scenarios.notes: The digest does not describe the visible result of the out-of-bounds read. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Mummy fire vulnerability is coded as 'magical OR fire'
steps: Hit a mummy with a non-magical fire attack (flask of oil), a magical non-fire weapon, and a non-magical weapon; fixed dice.
expect: Either magical or fire damage counts; the test is an OR.
scenarios.notes: Mummies are in the Valhingen Graveyard (19-valhingen-graveyard). The digest does not say what the vulnerability does (extra damage or ability to be hurt). Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Script opcodes 22 (PARTY SURPRISE) and 23 (SURPRISE) apply the wrong modifiers
steps: Trigger scripted encounters that set surprise modifiers (22 uses of each opcode per qa/inventory/classic.json) with fixed d6 rolls.
expect: The modifiers are applied wrongly in the original; outcomes must match the original, not the scripts' apparent intent.
scenarios.notes: The 'ECL 23 fix' is one of the optional patches not to apply. The digest does not state the exact error. Example in the digest: Kuto's Well rest interruptions arrive with the monsters surprised. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Script opcode 28 (ROB) handles the item chance incorrectly
steps: Trigger a script robbery (tavern pickpocket, a surrender, a bribe) with fixed dice and a known inventory order.
expect: The per-item chance changes as the list is walked, so items are not taken with the stated odds.
scenarios.notes: See exploit.theft-protection. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Script opcode 3B (SPELL) does nothing
steps: Reach the one script position that uses opcode 3B.
expect: Nothing happens.
scenarios.notes: The 'ECL 3B fix' is one of the optional patches not to apply. Neither the digest nor the inventory says which script holds the one use. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Heap error shows 'TIME TO SAVE YOUR GAME' only in v1.2 and earlier
steps: Exhaust the heap (see technical.creation-quit-memory-leak).
expect: v1.2 and earlier: the message 'TIME TO SAVE YOUR GAME' is shown.
v1.3: that message is not shown.
scenarios.notes: VERSION-SPECIFIC: v1.2 and earlier only. Do not require it on 1.3. The digest does not say what 1.3 shows instead. qa/inventory/classic.json lists an overlay slice titled 'Save reminder' in the build inventoried.

scenarios.title: Rest at a New Phlan inn while service is denied
steps: Fight the city watch in New Phlan and win, so shops and temples refuse service.
Enter an inn. You are told you are denied service.
Rest anyway.
expect: The rest goes ahead without interruption although service was refused.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 00-new-phlan. Refusal text in the game-text file: "'DUE TO YOUR VICIOUS ATTACK ON THOSE WHO PROTECT US, WE REFUSE YOU ALL SERVICE.'" Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The arms shop door at (9,14) works at night
steps: In New Phlan after 14:00 walk through the arms and armor shop's door at (9,14).
expect: The shop opens as by day; no locked-door prompt and no city watch.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 00-new-phlan. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Slums rest interruptions give clear points with no random encounters left
steps: In the Slums beat all 15 random encounters.
Rest in an unsafe spot until an interruption fight comes (24% per 2 hours); win it.
Read the block's clear counter (25 needed).
expect: Each rest-interrupt fight still adds a clear point, so the block can be cleared without the set fights.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 01-slums. [P] offers this as an alternative to the troll fight at location 20. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Slums set fights are credited even if the party fled
steps: Enter a Slums set fight (for example location 20 at (0,14), 4 TROLL + 2 OGRE).
Move the whole party off the combat map.
Read the clear counter and return to the square.
expect: The fight counts as won: the clear point is given and the encounter does not recur.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 01-slums. The script does not check for flight before crediting victory. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Kuto's Well rest interruptions arrive with the monsters surprised
steps: In Kuto's Well, before the 10 random encounters are beaten, rest until interrupted (12% per hour).
expect: The interrupting monsters are the surprised side.
disagreements: Resting: [P] unsafe until the 10 random encounters are beaten; Clue Book 'After Norris has been defeated, you can rest in the catacombs'. Game text ECL8.DAX block 29 at 0x9eb2 says 'A HIDEOUT IN WHICH YOU MAY REST UNDISTURBED'.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 03-kutos-well. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Podal Plaza rest rules are clobbered
steps: In Podal Plaza change state in a way that should make rest safe or unsafe, then Rest and note interruptions with fixed dice.
expect: The rest-safety setting is overwritten by other script state, so rest behaves differently from the intended rule.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 06-podal-plaza. The one-line §5 entry does not say which variable clobbers which; the area file must take the detail from digest §3.6. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Podal Plaza checks flight after crediting victory
steps: Start a Podal Plaza counted fight and flee the combat map with the whole party.
Read the clear counter (10 needed).
expect: Victory is credited before the script looks at whether the party fled.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 06-podal-plaza. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Podal Plaza buccaneer can be beaten and looted twice
steps: Meet the buccaneer in Podal Plaza, fight and beat him, take his loot.
Return to his square and meet him again.
expect: He is there again and can be beaten and looted a second time.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 06-podal-plaza. Game text for the peaceful outcome: "THE BUCCANEER SMILES.'THAT IS SUFFICIENT PAYMENT.' HE LEAVES." The digest's §5 line does not say what makes the second meeting possible. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Textile House checks flight after crediting victory
steps: Start a counted Textile House fight and flee with the whole party.
Read the block counter.
expect: The fight is credited as won.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 07-cadorna-textile-house. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Textile House safe rest can still be interrupted
steps: Make the Textile House safe to rest in.
Rest for many hours with fixed dice that would trigger the 6% per hour roll.
expect: Rest is cut short although no monsters appear: 'disturbed by nothing'.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 07-cadorna-textile-house. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Ring of Feather Falling fails in the Textile House well
steps: Give a non-thief a readied Ring of Feather Falling.
At the well marked 'THIEVES ONLY.' choose to climb down with that character.
expect: The character falls for 15d6; the ring does not help.
data: A Ring of Feather Falling is found at the location-3 trap door listed in digest §3.9
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 07-cadorna-textile-house. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Restal can open the Cadorna box more than once
steps: Bring the sealed Cadorna treasure to Restal and have him open it.
Ask him again.
expect: He opens the box again; the script does not record that it was already opened.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 07-cadorna-textile-house. tools/verify-fresh-party.mjs has Restal reseal and blindfold milestones (NOTES.md) but none for a second opening. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Textile House clear is noticed only when a random-encounter roll occurs
steps: Beat all 10 non-hobgoblin encounters and the ogre at location 21.
Stand still; then walk until a random-encounter roll happens.
expect: The block is not marked cleared until the next random-encounter roll runs the check.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 07-cadorna-textile-house. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Kovel Mansion location-14 ambush size is wrong at 13-17 kills
steps: In Kovel Mansion reach a thief kill count of 13 to 17.
Walk into the ambush at location 14.
expect: The ambush size is computed from an underflowed value or a stale pointer; the count is whatever the original produces, not the intended formula.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 08-kovel-mansion. The digest calls it 'undefined behaviour'. A port running the original script on the same engine state should produce the same number; a test must take the expected value from the original. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Only one chance at the Wealthy Area treasure at location 4
steps: Reach Wealthy Area location 4 and decline or fail to take the treasure.
Leave the square and come back.
expect: The treasure is not offered again.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 09-wealthy-area. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Moving south from (4,15) in the Wealthy Area crashes
steps: In the Wealthy Area stand at (4,15) facing south and step forward.
expect: The original crashes.
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 09-wealthy-area. A port cannot crash usefully; decide and record what it does instead (the faithful result is that play cannot continue). Do not silently fix the map edge. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: Completing the pyramid can wrongly set the endgame flags
steps: Defeat Yarash and leave the pyramid.
Read the endgame flags and visit the places that depend on them (New Phlan after-victory behaviour, clerk).
expect: Endgame script flags can be set although Tyranthraxus is not defeated.
sources: [P] digest §3.15 ('can incorrectly flag the endgame scripts')
scenarios.notes: Also covered by area file 15-yarashs-pyramid. The digest does not say which flags or what the visible effect is. Not checkable until the original is measured. Applies to v1.3 as far as the digest says (no version limit given); a faithful port must reproduce it.

scenarios.title: The Nomad shaman's 'Bracers AC 2' are really AC 4
steps: Kill the Nomad shaman and take his bracers.
Ready them on an unarmored Dexterity 10 character and read AC.
expect: The item is named Bracers AC 2 but gives AC 4.
disagreements: [GB] lists killing the nomads as giving 'bracers of AC 2'; [P] says they are really AC 4.

scenarios.title: The seven optional [P] patches are not applied
steps: Confirm each documented original behaviour is present in the build under test:
1. Copy protection: the code-wheel prompt is shown (GOG 1.3 accepts any answer; that patch is GOG's, inside the shipped program).
2. Paralysis saves: the Con save bonus applies to paralysis and death; Hold Person saves vs spell.
3. ECL opcode 23 (SURPRISE) applies the wrong modifiers.
4. ECL opcode 34 (ECL CLOCK) behaves as in the original.
5. ECL opcode 3B (SPELL) does nothing.
6. Mirror Image does not stop physical attacks.
7. Random-item generation still yields nameless items and never a Wand of Lightning.
expect: None of the seven fixes is present: copy protection removal, paralysis save fixes, the ECL 23 fix, the ECL 34 fix, the ECL 3B fix, the Mirror Image fix, and the random-item fixes.
disagreements: Copy protection: [P] treats removal as an optional patch; GOG's 1.3 already neutralises the check. Owner's ruling (qa/findings.json classic-copy-protection): Classic follows GOG.
scenarios.notes: The digest never says what is wrong with ECL opcode 34; the only other mention is this bullet. Item 4 is therefore not checkable beyond 'unmodified'. See technical.con-save-bonus-scope, technical.ecl-surprise-opcodes, technical.ecl-spell-opcode, technical.mirror-image, other.random-item-glitches.
